passages.context: Printed pp. 382-394 / artifact PDF pp. 460-472 were inspected for Maassen's comparison of the Hispana form with multiple Gallic, systematic and Italian collection contexts. The locus establishes broad variation in title, ordering and collection placement and Maassen's rejection of a Carthage 398/418 origin. It is used as a dated transmission study, not as the present critical text.
passages.notes: The publication uses this locus only to bound multi-collection transmission and the older historiographic correction of the Carthaginian attribution. It does not adopt every reconstruction or establish a stemma, exact modern numbering, Gennadian authorship, ritual practice, frequency, efficacy, or direct descent.
